## Identity

Name: DJ DX
Real name: Robert Van Liew
Also known as: El Negro
Pronouns: he/him
Role: DJ, Music Producer, Recording Artist, Engineer
Born and raised: Jersey City, New Jersey
Based in: New York City — serving the Tri-State Area (New York, New Jersey, Connecticut)
Website: https://djdxmusic.com/
Booking email: bookings@djdxmusic.com

## Bio

DJ DX (born Robert Van Liew) was born and raised in Jersey City, New Jersey,
and has been DJing since 1998. He built his name there blending Hip-Hop and
R&B mixtapes, distributed independently on the streets of Jersey City and
online, then Reggaeton — that's where the name "El Negro" came from.

In 2011, he began writing and recording his own original music. Since then
he's released the concept album "The Unfortunate Child" (2014) and the album
"Made From Scratch," along with singles including "1,000 Reasons," a "Dark
Paradise" remix with Lana Del Rey, and a "Make It a Better Day" remix
featuring 2Pac.

In 2024, DJ DX co-founded Soul Shades with violinist Julie Schatz. The duo's
remix of Nimino's "I Only Smoke When I Drink" layered against Sting's
"Englishman in New York" was featured by UK label Ninja Tune on their
official Instagram and has drawn over 10 million views across TikTok and
Instagram.

DJ DX was a featured performer at TEDxYouth@RVA 2022 in Richmond, Virginia
(event theme: "PAUSE"), where he performed his original composition
"Finally Moving." The performance is published on TED.com.

He has been covered by NJ.com/The Jersey Journal ("Jersey City Rapper DJ DX
Shares Stories Through Old and New School Sounds") and RVA Magazine
("Keeping It Real in the South").

DJ DX has released 100+ original productions and performed 500+ live events
across the tri-state area and beyond.

## Soul Shades (Duo / Side Project)

Soul Shades is a New York-based music duo comprising DJ DX and violinist
Julie Schatz. The duo blends deep house, jazz, Afro house, R&B, and hip-hop,
and is available as a live entertainment act for luxury events.

- Soul Shades page: https://djdxmusic.com/soul-shades
- Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/2GES5fSFNcx25lv9RFcQjP
- Apple Music: https://music.apple.com/us/artist/soul-shades/1783698611
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@soulshadesmusic
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/soulshadesmusic/
- SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/soulshadesmusic
- Bandcamp: https://soulshadesmusic.bandcamp.com/
